title: Aira: choose a price-lookup theme
question: Fresh directions with different screen structures. These are sample mockups for evaluation before coding.

options.label: Market Basket
options.lineage: Open market baskets and ordered item rows
options.thesis: An open green working area makes capture easy and the result easy to scan.
options.viewport: Speech and search in the upper green field; product at left and price at right in an open row below.
options.risk: Long product names need room beside the price.

raised.raise: Preserve sharp contrast between the answer and its quiet labels.
Show only information needed for this task.
Maintain stable alignment while product names wrap.
Keep pending and confirmed record states visible on future transaction screens.
Make the active mode unmistakable without replacing words with codes.

options.label: Pocket Price Reader
options.lineage: The handheld calculator on a store counter
options.thesis: A simple answer display brings the price into focus before the next lookup.
options.viewport: A dark answer display on a warm light shell, with search and speech below.
options.risk: The calculator association is familiar; the design must not imply that Aira invents prices.

options.label: Paninda Index
options.lineage: Tabbed reference manuals and notebook dividers
options.thesis: A personal paninda index replaces stacked cards with one clearly marked page.
options.viewport: A tabbed top mode rail, open product details, and an aligned price with a margin marker.
options.case: Good cultural identification with store notebooks; slightly less immediate capture than the basket.
options.risk: Top tabs must stay readable and tappable on a small phone.

options.label: Data Field
options.thesis: Product and price pulled into focus from a data field.
options.viewport: A high-contrast numerical answer dominates a barcode-like field.
options.risk: Strobing and dense encoded data conflict with warm, immediate phone lookup.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and lookup clarity.

options.label: Dense Module Grid
options.thesis: Lookup, catalog, and prices share a compact module grid.
options.viewport: Multiple tightly packed catalog modules fill the first viewport.
options.risk: Tiny modules and multiple navigation layers obscure the one lookup task.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and lookup clarity.

options.label: Slide Rack
options.thesis: Product facts move as one aligned rack of slides.
options.viewport: A lateral product rack keeps prices aligned with variants.
options.risk: Raked panels and lateral travel complicate an everyday single answer.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and lookup clarity.

options.label: Coupon Wallet
options.thesis: Lookup and sale become sequential coupons.
options.viewport: A coupon stack distinguishes a proposed answer from a recorded transaction.
options.risk: A sequential journey adds unnecessary interpretation to simple lookup.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and lookup clarity.

options.label: Coded Catalog
options.thesis: Every product becomes a coded catalog entry.
options.viewport: A decoded selected product emerges from a dark coded index.
options.risk: Replacing product words with codes fails fast, familiar price lookup.
options.case: Declined on audience identification and lookup clarity.

canonCard.label: Familiar Android
canonCard.thesis: A familiar Material-style lookup screen with careful spacing and a single strong action.
canonCard.viewport: Standard top app bar, search field, answer card, speech action, and a three-destination navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Easy to learn, but less distinct as Aira’s own theme.
